title: MPHarness - OTel (Logs / Traces)
description: Telemetry from batch test runs, not a long-running service. Every panel is LogQL over the structured log events mph emits (event=token_usage, iteration, agent_tool_call, tool_succeeded, tool_failed, context_compaction, context_compaction_applied, run_summary) plus Tempo traces. The $run variable picks one run by its Loki instance label, a <name>:<uuid> composite, so two runs sharing a name stay separate.

panels.title: Run name
panels.description: Selected run. `$run` is the composite `<name>:<uuid v7>` telemetry identity, read from the Loki `instance` stream label (the `service.instance.id` resource).

panels.title: Outcome
panels.description: The outcome field of the run's run_summary log event, logged once when the run ends: a run with no value has not finished. ok green, budget_exhausted yellow, error and timeout red.

targets.expr: sum by (attributes_outcome) (count_over_time({instance="$run"} |= "run_summary" | json | attributes_event="run_summary" [$__range]))

panels.title: Duration
panels.description: dur_ms of the run_summary event: wall time of the whole agent run.

targets.expr: max(max_over_time({instance="$run"} |= "run_summary" | json | attributes_event="run_summary" | unwrap attributes_dur_ms | __error__="" [$__range]))

panels.title: Iterations
panels.description: iterations of the run_summary event. An iteration that aborted the run is still counted.

targets.expr: max(max_over_time({instance="$run"} |= "run_summary" | json | attributes_event="run_summary" | unwrap attributes_iterations | __error__="" [$__range]))

panels.title: Prompt tokens
panels.description: prompt_tokens of the run_summary event: prompt tokens accumulated across the whole run.

targets.expr: max(max_over_time({instance="$run"} |= "run_summary" | json | attributes_event="run_summary" | unwrap attributes_prompt_tokens | __error__="" [$__range]))

panels.title: Completion tokens
panels.description: completion_tokens of the run_summary event: completion tokens accumulated across the whole run.

targets.expr: max(max_over_time({instance="$run"} |= "run_summary" | json | attributes_event="run_summary" | unwrap attributes_completion_tokens | __error__="" [$__range]))

panels.title: Reclaimed tokens
panels.description: reclaimed_tokens of the run_summary event: context tokens freed by applied compactions.

targets.expr: max(max_over_time({instance="$run"} |= "run_summary" | json | attributes_event="run_summary" | unwrap attributes_reclaimed_tokens | __error__="" [$__range]))

panels.title: Compactions
panels.description: compactions of the run_summary event: compactions applied during the run.

targets.expr: max(max_over_time({instance="$run"} |= "run_summary" | json | attributes_event="run_summary" | unwrap attributes_compactions | __error__="" [$__range]))

panels.title: Iteration duration split
panels.description: Per-iteration wall time from the iteration log event, split into model chat (chat_ms), tool execution (tool_ms) and overhead (dur_ms minus both).

targets.expr: max by (attributes_iter) (max_over_time({instance="$run"} |= "iteration" | json | attributes_event="iteration" | unwrap attributes_chat_ms | __error__="" [$__range]))
max by (attributes_iter) (max_over_time({instance="$run"} |= "iteration" | json | attributes_event="iteration" | unwrap attributes_tool_ms | __error__="" [$__range]))

max by (attributes_iter) (max_over_time({instance="$run"} |= "iteration" | json | attributes_event="iteration" | label_format overhead_ms="{{ sub (sub .attributes_dur_ms .attributes_chat_ms) .attributes_tool_ms }}" | unwrap overhead_ms | __error__="" [$__range]))

panels.title: Prefill TTFT
panels.description: ttft_ms and cached_tokens of each token_usage event. A cached_tokens of 0 is logged on purpose: the inference cache reused nothing that turn.

targets.expr: max by (attributes_iter) (max_over_time({instance="$run"} |= "token_usage" | json | attributes_event="token_usage" | unwrap attributes_ttft_ms | __error__="" [$__range]))
max by (attributes_iter) (max_over_time({instance="$run"} |= "token_usage" | json | attributes_event="token_usage" | unwrap attributes_cached_tokens | __error__="" [$__range]))

panels.title: Run traces
panels.description: One row per span for the selected run, so nested spans such as multipass.exec appear next to their parent. Select a row to open its trace in Explore. TraceQL search only covers flushed blocks, so a run becomes searchable about a minute after it finishes.

panels.title: Tokens per iteration
panels.description: prompt_tokens, completion_tokens and tps of each token_usage event.

targets.expr: max by (attributes_iter) (max_over_time({instance="$run"} |= "token_usage" | json | attributes_event="token_usage" | unwrap attributes_prompt_tokens | __error__="" [$__range]))
max by (attributes_iter) (max_over_time({instance="$run"} |= "token_usage" | json | attributes_event="token_usage" | unwrap attributes_completion_tokens | __error__="" [$__range]))
max by (attributes_iter) (max_over_time({instance="$run"} |= "token_usage" | json | attributes_event="token_usage" | unwrap attributes_tps | __error__="" [$__range]))

panels.title: Reasoning tokens per iteration
panels.description: reasoning_tokens of each token_usage event. 0 for models that do not reason.

targets.expr: max by (attributes_iter) (max_over_time({instance="$run"} |= "token_usage" | json | attributes_event="token_usage" | unwrap attributes_reasoning_tokens | __error__="" [$__range]))

panels.title: Context over time
panels.description: One point per token_usage event: context used (total_tokens) and remaining context (ctx_window minus total_tokens), plus tok_after of each applied context_compaction. Points are raw log lines rather than time buckets, so the time axis spans the run itself, not the dashboard range; the range only has to include the run.

targets.expr: {instance="$run"} |= "token_usage" | json | attributes_event="token_usage" | label_format remaining="{{ sub .attributes_ctx_window .attributes_total_tokens }}" | keep attributes_total_tokens, remaining
{instance="$run"} |= "context_compaction" | json | attributes_event="context_compaction" | attributes_outcome="applied" | keep attributes_tok_after

panels.title: Tokens reclaimed per iteration
panels.description: reclaimed of each applied context_compaction event (tok_before minus tok_after).

targets.expr: max by (attributes_iter) (max_over_time({instance="$run"} |= "context_compaction" | json | attributes_event="context_compaction" | attributes_outcome="applied" | unwrap attributes_reclaimed | __error__="" [$__range]))

panels.title: Compaction events
panels.description: One row per context_compaction event: outcome, context before and after, tokens reclaimed and duration. applied means the rewritten history shrank, reverted means it did not, failed means the summary call errored or came back empty.

targets.expr: max by (attributes_iter, attributes_outcome) (max_over_time({instance="$run"} |= "context_compaction" | json | attributes_event="context_compaction" | unwrap attributes_tok_before | __error__="" [$__range]))

max by (attributes_iter, attributes_outcome) (max_over_time({instance="$run"} |= "context_compaction" | json | attributes_event="context_compaction" | unwrap attributes_tok_after | __error__="" [$__range]))

max by (attributes_iter, attributes_outcome) (max_over_time({instance="$run"} |= "context_compaction" | json | attributes_event="context_compaction" | unwrap attributes_reclaimed | __error__="" [$__range]))

max by (attributes_iter, attributes_outcome) (max_over_time({instance="$run"} |= "context_compaction" | json | attributes_event="context_compaction" | unwrap attributes_dur_ms | __error__="" [$__range]))

panels.title: Tool duration per iteration
panels.description: Sum of dur_ms over the tool_succeeded and tool_failed events of each iteration, per tool.

targets.expr: sum by (attributes_iter, attributes_tool) (sum_over_time({instance="$run"} |~ "tool_(succeeded|failed)" | json | attributes_event=~"tool_(succeeded|failed)" | unwrap attributes_dur_ms | __error__="" [$__range]))
sum by (attributes_iter, attributes_tool) (count_over_time({instance="$run"} |~ "tool_(succeeded|failed)" | json | attributes_event=~"tool_(succeeded|failed)" [$__range]))

panels.title: Per-tool rollup
panels.description: Calls and failures counted from the tool_succeeded and tool_failed events, with the p95 of their dur_ms.

targets.expr: sum by (attributes_tool) (count_over_time({instance="$run"} |~ "tool_(succeeded|failed)" | json | attributes_event=~"tool_(succeeded|failed)" [$__range]))
sum by (attributes_tool) (count_over_time({instance="$run"} |~ "tool_(succeeded|failed)" | json | attributes_event=~"tool_failed" [$__range]))
quantile_over_time(0.95, {instance="$run"} |~ "tool_(succeeded|failed)" | json | attributes_event=~"tool_(succeeded|failed)" | unwrap attributes_dur_ms | __error__="" [$__range]) by (attributes_tool)

panels.title: All runs
panels.description: One row per run_summary event in the range. Runs sharing a name are separate rows because the instance label carries the uuid.

targets.expr: max by (instance, attributes_outcome) (max_over_time({instance=~".+"} |= "run_summary" | json | attributes_event="run_summary" | unwrap attributes_iterations | __error__="" [$__range]))
max by (instance, attributes_outcome) (max_over_time({instance=~".+"} |= "run_summary" | json | attributes_event="run_summary" | unwrap attributes_prompt_tokens | __error__="" [$__range]))
max by (instance, attributes_outcome) (max_over_time({instance=~".+"} |= "run_summary" | json | attributes_event="run_summary" | unwrap attributes_completion_tokens | __error__="" [$__range]))
max by (instance, attributes_outcome) (max_over_time({instance=~".+"} |= "run_summary" | json | attributes_event="run_summary" | unwrap attributes_reclaimed_tokens | __error__="" [$__range]))
max by (instance, attributes_outcome) (max_over_time({instance=~".+"} |= "run_summary" | json | attributes_event="run_summary" | unwrap attributes_compactions | __error__="" [$__range]))
max by (instance, attributes_outcome) (max_over_time({instance=~".+"} |= "run_summary" | json | attributes_event="run_summary" | unwrap attributes_tool_calls | __error__="" [$__range]))
max by (instance, attributes_outcome) (max_over_time({instance=~".+"} |= "run_summary" | json | attributes_event="run_summary" | unwrap attributes_tool_failures | __error__="" [$__range]))
max by (instance, attributes_outcome) (max_over_time({instance=~".+"} |= "run_summary" | json | attributes_event="run_summary" | unwrap attributes_dur_ms | __error__="" [$__range]))

panels.title: Duration across runs
panels.description: dur_ms of every run_summary event in the range, one bar per run.

targets.expr: max by (instance) (max_over_time({instance=~".+"} |= "run_summary" | json | attributes_event="run_summary" | unwrap attributes_dur_ms | __error__="" [$__range]))

panels.title: Run log
panels.description: Filtered to the selected run. Model output arrives under the body "model output", split by attributes.part (content or reasoning). The unfiltered equivalent is in the Logs row below.

targets.expr: {instance="$run"}

panels.title: Run warnings and errors
panels.description: Warn, error and fatal records for the selected run. Matches the severity field inside each record, not the level stream label. A quiet run correctly shows no rows.

targets.expr: {instance="$run"} | json | severity=~"warn|error|fatal"

panels.title: Log lines with trace correlation
panels.description: Caller attribution was removed from the logger, so this shows the message with its trace and span ids. The model text itself arrives under body="model output" split by attributes.part (content or reasoning) with the payload in attributes.text.

targets.expr: {service_name=~".+"} | json

panels.title: OTLP received per interval (spans / logs)
panels.description: Records arriving per interval, so gaps in traffic read as zero. Spans and log records differ by orders of magnitude, so read the shape rather than the height.

targets.expr: sum(increase(otelcol_receiver_accepted_spans_total[$__rate_interval]))
sum(increase(otelcol_receiver_accepted_log_records_total[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Export failures (should stay flat at zero)
panels.description: Any non-zero value means telemetry was dropped on the way to Tempo / Prometheus / Loki.

targets.expr: sum by (otelcol_exporter) (increase(otelcol_exporter_send_failed_spans_total[$__range]))
sum by (otelcol_exporter) (increase(otelcol_exporter_send_failed_log_records_total[$__range]))
